violations.description: Hot storage of potentially hazardous food. — --Hot food storage facilities/equipment was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining temperature of potentially hazardous food at 140F or greater. Hot hold with mashed potatoes temped at 132F.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food prepared and packaged by a processing plant was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days after original package was opened. Prepared salads on food line did not have proper date markings.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. Walk in freezer has ice on condenser.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Observed food condiments, pickles tomatoes, lettuce on the center island, not being protected from potential contamination.
